current_prompt.body:
DESIGN a REST API for a simple bookmarks service with CRUD endpoints for bookmarks.
DEFINE bookmark fields: url, title, tags, created_at.
INCLUDE an endpoint to search bookmarks by tag.
IMPLEMENT the API using only Python standard library modules: http.server, json, urllib.
GENERATE an OpenAPI 3.0 specification (YAML or JSON) describing all endpoints, request/response schemas, status codes, and example values.
PROVIDE a self-contained test script that starts the server, performs all CRUD operations, executes a tag search, and verifies the responses.

current_plan.body:
DESIGN the REST API endpoints for bookmarks with CRUD operations and a tag-search endpoint
DEFINE the data model fields: url, title, tags, created_at
SPECIFY request and response schemas for each endpoint using OpenAPI 3.0 components
GENERATE the OpenAPI 3.0 specification document in YAML format covering paths, methods, parameters, request bodies, responses, status codes, and example values
IMPLEMENT the API server using Python standard library modules (http.server, json, urllib) adhering to the defined endpoints and data model
WRITE a self‑contained test script that starts the server, performs CREATE, READ, UPDATE, DELETE operations, executes a tag‑based search request, and validates the returned responses against expected structures and values
